Root cause. The read-side bounds check accepts `builtInTypeId == SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` even though `SOPC_BuiltinId` ends at 25 and the built-in handling/encoding tables only have valid indices 0..25. The fix tightens this guard to `> SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX`.
